name: Mae Moh Half Marathon
short_description: The Mae Moh Half Marathon is a 21.1km, 10km, and 5km race held in Mae Moh, Lampang, Thailand on October 25, 2026.
ai_summary: The Mae Moh Half Marathon is a running event scheduled for October 25, 2026, in Mae Moh, Lampang, Thailand. Organized by the Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand (EGAT), the race offers three distance options: 21.1km, 10km, and 5km, making it accessible to a range of runners. Registration details have not yet been announced.
pros: Multiple distance options (21.1km, 10km, 5km) suit different fitness levels
Organized by a well-established institution, EGAT
Set in Mae Moh, Lampang, a specific regional Thai location
cons: Registration status has not yet been announced, so sign-up details are unavailable

research_highlights: Course is World Athletics Road Race Label certified — organizers advertise it as the first World Athletics-standard race course in northern Thailand.
Roads are 100% closed to traffic for the race, and medical support is staffed with personnel trained to international standards, according to EGAT's official race announcements.
Route runs scenically around the Mae Moh power plant, the Mae Moh mine, the Huai Ped and Mae Kham reservoirs, limestone hills, and seasonal flower fields (cosmos, kaew mangkorn, sunn hemp).
Held annually in mid-to-late October (around 19–25 October in recent years), which participants describe as offering cool, comfortable weather for running.
One runner described a course with only minor hills ('เนินน้อยแต่วิ่งสนุก') and praised the professional-level organization, calling it deserving of its world-standard certification.
research_watchouts: Route has been changed between editions in the past (a runner noted the course changed rather than repeating the same route), so returning participants shouldn't assume the exact route stays identical year to year.
The event was suspended for two years due to COVID-19 before resuming in 2022, indicating past scheduling disruptions.

Being a large regional event (thousands of participants — around 4,000 in the 2025 edition), logistics like registration, transport, and accommodation in the smaller town of Mae Moh may require early planning.

faqs.question: When is the Mae Moh Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: The Mae Moh Half Marathon is scheduled to take place on October 25, 2026. It is held in Mae Moh, Lampang, Thailand. No further schedule details, such as start times, have been announced yet for this event.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at the Mae Moh Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: The event offers three distance categories for participants to choose from: a 21.1km half marathon, a 10km race, and a 5km race. The 21.1km half marathon is considered the primary distance of this event.

faqs.question: Who organizes the Mae Moh Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: The Mae Moh Half Marathon is organized by the Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand, commonly known as EGAT. The event takes place in Mae Moh, Lampang, Thailand, reflecting the organizer's connection to the local region.

faqs.question: Is registration open for the Mae Moh Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: Registration for the Mae Moh Half Marathon has not yet been announced. Prospective participants interested in the 21.1km, 10km, or 5km distances will need to wait for further updates regarding sign-up details and availability.
